scope: Presentation subtask source and executed software evidence, not a final exported-candidate acceptance ledger.

findings.title: Legal fighter separation exceeds visible arena width
findings.implemented: A deterministic stateless presentation camera fits both complete source-cel envelopes, both facings and vertical positions; every rendered world object shares the same projection. Core movement and arena bounds are unchanged.
remaining_limitations: Pure checks cover all source rectangles, separated corners and heights. Development native foundry corners and jumps passed and were visually inspected; its later contact setup failed because the old fixed approach stopped too early. The fixture now approaches actual pushbox distance, capped at 240 legal ticks; rerun is required for all four stages.

findings.title: All presentation events wait for confirmed remote input
findings.implemented: The adapter consumes only keyed Add/Confirm/Cancel changes. Local reversible action/jump/dash cues appear speculatively once; correction removes their keyed visuals/audio. Confirm does not replay them. Economic and terminal outcomes stay confirmed.
remaining_limitations: Application rollback contract and tests are owned by the session agent; this report does not relabel their evidence as independently executed here. Final two-peer correction/audio capture remains required.

findings.title: Delayed impacts use current positions rather than contact-time positions
findings.implemented: Impact placement prefers Core event-time WorldX/WorldY, SourceFighterId and source move identity; delayed cues retain their original contact location and age, with fallbacks only when event metadata is absent.
remaining_limitations: Final latency/correction capture must demonstrate contact points after both actors move; Core contact metadata tests are reported separately.

findings.title: Canonical serialization allocates repeatedly in the hot path
findings.implemented: Presentation diagnostics separate adapter/draw/overlay costs from gameplay and record GC deltas. Serialization and replay allocation optimization belongs to Core/App owners, not this renderer change.
remaining_limitations: Do not close PP-038 from rendering checks. Use the Core/App allocation benchmark and actual match profiler evidence.

findings.title: The recorded half-second frame outlier is unattributed
findings.implemented: Opt-in profiling records callback distributions, frame phases, >=40ms stalls, GC deltas, managed bytes and movie-capture context. Object overlays have a separate measured scope.
remaining_limitations: No current native pacing run is claimed. C# timing excludes GPU work after submission and includes OS scheduling. A low C# time or absent GC alone cannot establish the cause of a stall.

findings.title: Hurt silhouettes are generic outside active hitbox extension
findings.implemented: Debug rectangles are derived from actual simulation hurt/hit/push/object geometry and use the same camera projection as artwork; field markers distinguish inactive versus contact-active geometry.
remaining_limitations: Authoring action-specific Core hurt silhouettes is outside this presentation task. Debug agreement is not evidence that every pose has ideal hurt geometry.

findings.title: Mapped move phases are not complete bespoke animations
findings.implemented: Explicit phase/state bindings distinguish walk directions, neutral transitions, Slipstream follow-ups, Rivet branches, kicks and feint aborts using inspected existing cels. Feints render the exact source anticipation for six ticks. Vault follows actual airborne state; held startup stays on Core action frame.
remaining_limitations: No new authored in-between animation set or dedicated air-throw/branch/dive sheet is claimed. The register names reused cels for all 31 new runtime action nodes. Complete bespoke animation remains unfinished.

findings.title: Cel timing is uniformly distributed within broad action phases
findings.implemented: Animation timing is explicit per-cel integer tick holds, including contact follow-through, settle and state loops. Selection uses canonical action frame rather than uniform phase subdivision.
remaining_limitations: The pure checks verify duration coverage, positive holds, known cels and exact feint anticipation/abort. Final native per-action playback and human cadence review remain required.

findings.title: Runtime magenta keying is a provisional asset pipeline
findings.implemented: One original-board image-generation alpha experiment was inspected and rejected: it was RGB with painted checkerboard, not real alpha. Shipped source boards were not replaced.
remaining_limitations: The runtime still uses chroma-key RGB boards. Genuine registered RGBA assets and alpha-boundary validation remain outstanding; shader cleanup is not claimed as authored alpha.

findings.title: Heuristic palette recoloring is fragile
findings.implemented: Existing alternate-palette heuristics remain unchanged; ownership labels and non-color-only field shapes improve object readability without claiming a material mask.
remaining_limitations: No authored skin/hair/cloth palette masks were produced. Both mirror palettes require final visual review, and long-term mask authoring remains outstanding.

findings.title: Portraits are stretched into incompatible aspect ratios
findings.implemented: Selection and HUD portraits preserve source aspect through contain/KeepAspectCentered behavior; missing fighter art has a visible development placeholder.
remaining_limitations: Development lineup portraits were visually inspected and proportionate. Final candidate and UI scale variants have not yet been reviewed.

findings.title: Menu layout and focus ownership depend on pixel coordinates
findings.implemented: Preparation skin refresh resolves root-owned semantic purchaseButtons[(Seat,Row)] rather than deriving ownership from pixel positions.
remaining_limitations: Root owns semantic focus routing and controller menu tests. Much layout still uses a 1280x720 canvas; large text and alternate display/UI-scale evidence are not supplied here.

findings.title: Typography and shop labels do not yet match the authored art direction
findings.implemented: Licensed Barlow body/condensed headings replace generic typography; the title is live PENNY PUNCHERS text. Shop labels, portraits and live names remain functional text.
remaining_limitations: Development lineup and preparation PNGs read cleanly at 1280x720. Final small-window/couch readability and accessibility review remain pending.

findings.title: HUD assumes fixed health and art-price formulas
findings.implemented: Health fill and damage trail use each player MaxHealth. Selected-art cost and EX minimum/range use canonical current content; affordability uses actual credits less protected savings.
remaining_limitations: Native temporary MaxHealth/cost variation test remains required. Root catalog/lineup costs are outside this file and must use the same content.

findings.title: Resource readability can improve without restoring a combat meter
findings.implemented: The HUD shows one credit wallet, protected savings, spendable amount, selected-art shortage/affordability and EX availability. Damage trail and stun are separate; Overtime is an expiring install icon/countdown, not a second earned resource.
remaining_limitations: The old dev screenshot contains a lease/SAVED overlap, fixed in current source by removing legacy DrawLeaseSummary and placing loadout at baseline158. Verify rebuilt screenshots. Human one-wallet comprehension has not been tested.

findings.title: Stage presentation is largely one scrolling image
findings.implemented: Original Marist Green and Marist Gates panoramas/select cards are imported unchanged with source/runtime hashes and source attribution; third-party reference photos are excluded. Stage-specific procedural ambience, ground presentation and original synthesized loops are added.
remaining_limitations: Each new background remains one authored panorama; no independently authored parallax layers are claimed. Final stage native playthrough, palette/readability and pacing/audio checks remain pending.

findings.title: Generic impact selection understates move identity
findings.implemented: Explicit per-move profiles control weight, shake, lifetime, FX atlas range and sound. Event metadata positions contact cues; counters, armor, reflection, interception, anchor phases and prism collision pips use distinct contextual cues.
remaining_limitations: Raster FX still reuse the original authored library. Final high-density/reduced-flash readability, freeze timing and human move-recognition checks remain pending.

findings.title: Cosmetic wall-clock aging needs pause and frame-advance review
findings.implemented: Combat effects, state age, wallet cues and shake advance using simulation ticks with freeze gates. ResetPresentationTimeline clears transient keys/timers on replay/new-simulation/reset. Environmental ambience alone uses wall time.
remaining_limitations: The native legal-contact pause check did not execute after the old approach fixture failed; the corrected bounded approach is saved but not yet rerun. Final pause/frame-step/seek/rollback visual tests remain required.

findings.title: Audio has a foundation but limited variation and character identity
findings.implemented: Twenty-four original PCM files include deterministic hit/heavy variants, synthesized fighter breaths and two stage loops. A bounded sixteen-voice priority pool protects defensive/terminal cues; cancellation removes speculative audio and explicit shutdown releases streams.
remaining_limitations: PCM non-silence/peak/hash validation passed, not speaker validation. Breaths are synthetic noise, not recorded human performances. Dense native mix, cancellation and blind character/defense recognition tests remain pending.

findings.title: Terminal feedback does not consistently distinguish result reasons
findings.implemented: Terminal banner derives actual reason and winner: TIME UP, TIME / DRAW, DOUBLE K.O. or K.O. Timeout has a terminal audio cue and economic outcomes remain confirmed.
remaining_limitations: Final native KO/timeout/double-KO/draw/early-clinch result matrix is not run here. Root owns terminal match/point rules and result menus.

isolated_presentation_compile.scope: game/Presentation C# against GodotSharp; does not compile Main/Core/App

development_native_review.scope: Partial root-run Debug software-injected UI, not a complete pass and not physical controller certification. Paths may be replaced by the next development run; the hashes identify the bytes actually reviewed.
development_native_review.failure: Old fixed 115-tick approach did not reach heavy-contact range; Main.StageEvidence now uses actual pushbox distance with a 240-tick bound. Rerun pending.
